searchText: IMO Ropsten should have proposer boost enabled on the CL side. I've opened a PR here with that change: https://github.com/eth-clients/merge-testnets/pull/10 Dang it, we just put out our release with ropsten config. Not consensus breaking so probably still worth changing but most teku users will wind up with it disabled. Maybe that makes the testing ultra realistic, on mainnet there are lots of nodes that still don't have it enabled either 😉 We could hold back on proposer boost, but I think it would also be fine for some clients to have it while others don't, and then get it in the next routine release We have it enabled by default on both mainnet and Ropsten But unfortunately it's still 70% We are releasing on Thurs/Friday, it'll be 40% It's failing now though 😋 Waiting for https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2896 to merge. The only remaining failing test depends on `mainnet.yaml`. We just have to point it to the official release commit Yep, I agree we should go ahead an enable it on Ropsten. Ah yeah, I'd forgotten the EF tests would fail. I guess Lighthouse is blocked on that too. We'd kind of like to do our release today so maybe we'll go ahead with 70% everywhere
